alt_text: Per-event panels compare verified transportation cohorts across distance, duration, available Kubios heart-rate and HRV, and mechanical metrics. Counts and missing values vary by cohort.
interpretation: Transportation profiles vary across passive-passenger and active-controlled contexts; sparse modes and missing modalities remain visible.
limitations: Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
long_description: Transportation profiles vary across passive-passenger and active-controlled contexts; sparse modes and missing modalities remain visible. SilverRide remains distinct from other sedan/taxi records. Motorcycle remains active controlled and is not interpreted as passive passenger exposure. Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
qualifications: SilverRide remains distinct from other sedan/taxi records.
Motorcycle remains active controlled and is not interpreted as passive passenger exposure.
title: Transportation and body-coupling comparison
